content: अराल {%a.%} [ऋ-विच् अरम् आलाति, ला क] Spreading like the spokes of a wheel, curved, crooked; ‘अरालः कुटिले मतः इति’ मेदिनीकरः; <ls>Māl. 9. 34</ls>; पादावरालाङ्गुली <ls>M. 2. 3</ls>. .{@-लः@} .²1 A bent or crooked arm. .²2 The resin of the plant Shorea Robusta (सर्जरस; <lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>राळ</ns>). .²3 An elephant in rut. .{@-ला@} .²1 An unchaste woman, harlot, courtezan. .²2 A modest woman (अधृष्टा).
